content: modelcontextprotocol/registry README (primary): publish via mcp-publisher CLI from the server's own project (PRs adding server.json do NOT publish); namespace ownership validated - GitHub OAuth, GitHub OIDC (Actions), DNS or HTTP verification; io.github.<user>/<name> requires logging in as that user. server.json field details live in docs/quickstart (not README). SIF needs a GitHub-authenticated namespace (io.github.zhangtaolab/...) and a published PyPI package reference.
